verdict.rationale: Jan runs models locally by default, giving users a form of data residency control since data can remain entirely on-device rather than in any cloud region (jan-gh-6, jan-gh-11, jan-docs-2). However, there is no documented feature for choosing a specific storage region/jurisdiction (e.g., EU vs US) when using cloud model integrations, and no explicit data-residency policy or settings are evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection UI or docs, data-residency policy for cloud-connected mode, independent confirmation of data locality guarantees.
